sub_graphs.title: Altair P2P: Fork Transition Mechanics
sub_graphs.description: Models how the P2P layer transitions between pre-fork and post-fork topic subscriptions

nodes.label: Pre-Fork State
nodes.description: System is running pre-Altair P2P protocol

nodes.label: Subscribe to Post-Fork Topics
nodes.description: Before fork epoch, nodes subscribe to Altair topic variants alongside existing Phase 0 topics

nodes.label: Dual Topic Subscription Active
nodes.description: Node is subscribed to both pre-fork and post-fork gossip topics

nodes.label: Fork Epoch Activated
nodes.description: Fork epoch reached; post-fork messages accepted, pre-fork messages ignored with clock disparity tolerance

nodes.label: Share Application-Level Caches
nodes.description: Application-level caches (deduplication) shared between fork variants to prevent reprocessing

nodes.label: Unsubscribe Pre-Fork Topics
nodes.description: Two epochs after fork, unsubscribe from pre-fork topic variants

nodes.label: Post-Fork State
nodes.description: Node is fully transitioned to Altair P2P protocol

sub_graphs.title: Altair P2P: Message ID Derivation and Integrity
sub_graphs.description: Models the message ID computation that prevents message spoofing and ensures deduplication

nodes.label: Gossip Message Received
nodes.description: A raw gossip message has been received from a peer

nodes.label: Attempt Snappy Decompression
nodes.description: Try to decompress the message payload using Snappy

nodes.label: Compute Valid Message ID
nodes.description: SHA256(MESSAGE_DOMAIN_VALID_SNAPPY + uint_to_bytes(len(topic)) + topic + decompressed_data), take first 20 bytes

nodes.label: Compute Invalid Message ID
nodes.description: SHA256(MESSAGE_DOMAIN_INVALID_SNAPPY + uint_to_bytes(len(topic)) + topic + raw_data), take first 20 bytes

nodes.label: Message ID Assigned
nodes.description: Message has a unique ID for deduplication and tracking

ambiguities.text: The spec says nodes should subscribe to post-fork topics 'before' the fork epoch but does not specify exactly how many epochs before.
ambiguities.resolution_strategy: Assume nodes subscribe 1-2 epochs before the fork epoch to ensure readiness.

ambiguities.text: Messages are 'not rebroadcast between fork variants' but the interaction with shared application-level caches is not fully specified.
ambiguities.resolution_strategy: Assume shared caches prevent reprocessing but messages are never reformatted from one fork's topic to another.

ambiguities.text: The get_sync_subcommittee_pubkeys helper handles the 'exceptional logic when transitioning between sync committee periods' but the exact exceptional cases are not enumerated.
ambiguities.resolution_strategy: Assume this refers to the boundary when current and next sync committees swap, requiring correct committee selection based on epoch.

implicit_assumptions.description: MAXIMUM_GOSSIP_CLOCK_DISPARITY is assumed to be sufficient to account for real-world clock drift between nodes.
implicit_assumptions.impact_if_false: Nodes with slightly drifted clocks could reject valid sync committee messages, reducing participation rates.

implicit_assumptions.description: An attacker cannot create valid Snappy-compressed messages that decompress to different content than intended, to manipulate message IDs.
implicit_assumptions.impact_if_false: Message ID collisions could be exploited to suppress legitimate messages via deduplication.

implicit_assumptions.description: The gossipsub protocol provides sufficient spam resistance through scoring and rate limiting for sync committee topics.
implicit_assumptions.impact_if_false: Attackers could flood sync committee subnets with invalid messages, degrading network performance.
